title: Schema Playground & Validation Lens — quickstart visual asset set
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a compact, re-usable visual asset set and screenshot pack for the Structured Output quickstart that demonstrates the Schema Playground and the Validation Lens UI. These assets are intended for (1) the interactive quickstart in Docs, (2) the in-console onboarding modal, and (3) the release notes hero image.

Scope: Design a small set of responsive mockups + annotated screenshots: a) Schema Playground (live schema edit + example input + sample generation result) b) Validation Lens (inline error/warning highlights with suggestions) c) Compact microcopy variants for onboarding steps d) Screenshot-ready variants for light/dark console themes. Provide Figma frames, exported PNG/SVG assets, and a short dev handoff doc (tokens, spacing, hover states).

Non-goals: Building the actual React component or implementing runtime validation — this ticket is visual design + assets for handoff. The engineering implementation is tracked in ENG-2543.
acceptance_criteria: Hi-fi Figma frames for Schema Playground and Validation Lens approved by PM and Eng
Annotated screenshots (4 sizes: 320px, 768px, 1280px, 1920px) exported in PNG and SVG where applicable
Microcopy variants (short, normal, expanded) reviewed and copy-safety checked
Dev handoff doc with tokens, spacing, and interaction notes uploaded to Drive and linked
Design sign-off recorded in comments and PRD linked (PM-412)
deliverables: Figma file: Schema Playground + Validation Lens frames (desktop/tablet/mobile)
Screenshot pack: 8 PNGs (light/dark × 4 sizes) and 2 SVG hero images
Annotated PDF with accessibility contrast checks and callouts
Handoff doc: dev-tokens.md with hover/active states, error colours, animation durations
One-page microcopy guide (.md) with step-by-step UI text for quickstart and modal
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Patel: Kickoff — aligned product and engineering on scope. Agreed to keep the Playground minimal: schema editor, example input, generated output, and an inline validator pane.
2025-02-14 Liam Chen: Early comps posted to Figma (link below). PM requested an explicit 'why this schema matters' tooltip for first-time users.
2025-02-17 Aria Gomez (PM): Reviewed; ask to add an empty-state flow for when validation is pending (API latency). Also prefer red/orange gradient for severity vs single red only.
2025-02-19 Engineering review (ENG-2543): Feasibility OK for inline highlights; suggested we keep max 3 severity levels to simplify implementation. Also requested pixel-exact export guidelines.
2025-02-20 Liam Chen: Updated assets with accessibility contrast fixes and exported dark-theme PNGs. Preparing handoff bundle.
implementation_notes: Keep the playground chrome minimal. Use monospace for schema editor, variable tokens for example inputs, and inline diff-style highlights for validation errors. Provide three severity states: info/warning/error. Motion: subtle fade in for new validation markers (120ms). Export guidelines: 2x assets for retina, 72dpi PNGs, and SVGs for wire/vector elements.

Microcopy has no more than 90 characters per line in modal width
